name: Bishoujo Mangekyou -Kami ga Tsukuritamouta Shoujo-tachi-
original_name: 美少女万華鏡 -神が造りたもうた少女たち-
source:
In an unknown era.
Long after humanity's golden age crumbled to dust, and eons rolled by like waves...

In a realm where the horizon bled into oblivion, a solitary scientist, the last of his kind, dwelled within a tower.

Marooned in this desolate expanse, his heart yearned for companionship.
Armed with arcane knowledge from a long-lost civilization, he wielded technology akin to sorcery and finally created the ideal maid robot into existence.

[Translated from [url=http://www.omega-star.jp/biman3html/story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
在一个未知的时代。
在人类的黄金时代化为尘埃、万古如波涛滚滚过去很久之后……

在地平线逐渐消失的国度里，一位孤独的科学家，他的同类中的最后一个，住在一座塔楼里。

被困在这荒凉的地方，他的心渴望有人陪伴。
凭借来自失落已久的文明的神秘知识，他运用了类似于魔法的技术，最终创造出了理想的女仆机器人。

[译自[url=http://www.omega-star.jp/biman3html/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
